dialect_policy.bidayuh: Preserve source variety labels (Singhi/Bau, Biatah, Bukar-Sadong, etc.). Do not silently merge varieties.
dialect_policy.kadazan-dusun: Preserve Bundu/Central Dusun vs Taginambur/Kadazan labels.
dialect_policy.iban: Attach dialect_variant only when a pack source specifies one.
dialect_policy.mah-meri: Label Skeat forms as historical Besisi; ASJP as Mah Meri (ASJP orthography).
